verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Keycloak exposes an Admin REST API and OIDC/SAML protocol endpoints, but nothing in the pack documents API versioning scheme or a formal deprecation policy; probes for OpenAPI/llms.txt specs return 404s, and community feedback even calls the API 'inconsistent' for idempotent management (keycloak-comm-13). No first-party or independent evidence of a documented versioning/deprecation policy exists.
